consumer_instructions.repository: Open the relative paths in canonical_source_records; each file is pinned by its Git blob and SHA-256.
consumer_instructions.offline_package: core.json contains all accepted record objects; INDEX.json contains this entrypoint; original UTF-8 records retain their repository paths.
consumer_instructions.mechanics_filter: Use protected_mechanical_class for rule_exact, rule_procedure, equipment_stat and character_option; retain relevant campaign_guidance as labeled.
consumer_instructions.provenance: The included source manifest preserves the complete per-record source-review and transaction evidence. Chapter original-source receipts are referenced by the included closure queue.
consumer_instructions.interpretation: Preserve edition, optional rules, exceptions, formulas, source discrepancies and literal values; this export adds no interpretation.

known_limitations.printed_internal_rule_disagreements: Preserved in accepted records; no newly inferred precedence or invented errata.
known_limitations.source_wide_narrative_archival_status: Separate from this available-source gameplay-data release.
known_limitations.game_engine_implementation: This is canonical rules/data, not a complete executable game engine.
